program_name: Management & Business Analytics (official name is identical in Italian and English; abbreviated 'MBA' in UNIUD international notices). Offered by the Department of Economics and Statistics (DIES).
teaching_language: English. The programme is delivered entirely in English; it is the only fully English-taught bachelor's degree at the University of Udine. The Economia study manifesto explicitly distinguishes 'i corsi erogati in lingua italiana' from 'il corso in inglese' (Management & Business Analytics), and the international notices list it under 'DEGREES TAUGHT ENTIRELY IN ENGLISH'.
campus: Udine (sede di Udine), Italy. Department of Economics and Statistics (DIES).
degree_class: L-18 (Scienze dell'economia e della gestione aziendale / Business administration). Single class, not an interclass programme. Duration 3 years, 180 ECTS.
admission_type: Restricted access - 'accesso programmato locale' with places assigned in chronological order of enrolment application (not a competitive ranking/merit exam). In addition: (a) a mandatory initial-preparation test (CEnT-S, CISIA) that does NOT bar admission but determines OFA; (b) for candidates holding a foreign qualification, a compulsory pre-evaluation application on the Elix-Forms platform followed by an online selection interview set by the Teaching Evaluation Committee. Note: Management & Business Analytics is NOT included in the UNIUD list of 'programmazione locale' courses that require a selective admission test.
access_type_detail: 'Accesso programmato locale' with 100 total places. Manifesto degli studi Economia 2026/27: 'Management & Business Analytics, classe L-18, sede di Udine. Accesso programmato: 100 posti accolti in ordine cronologico, di cui 30 riservati a studenti stranieri non appartenenti all'UE e residenti all'estero.' Enrolment applications are accepted in chronological order until places are exhausted; if places run out before 5 October 2026 a waiting list is created and candidates are ranked by the chronological order of their waiting-list request.
academic_requirements: Upper-secondary school leaving diploma ('diploma di scuola secondaria superiore') or another qualification obtained abroad recognised as suitable under D.M. 270/2004, art. 6. For candidates with a foreign qualification, the title must allow access to first-cycle courses in the issuing system and must be accompanied by a Dichiarazione di Valore or a CIMEA statement of verification (holders of qualifications from the 55 Lisbon Convention signatory countries may download the ARDI automatic-recognition statement from www.ardi.cimea.it but must still request the CIMEA Attestato di verifica). In addition, and specific to this programme, an English language level not lower than CEFR B2 is required: 'Per essere ammessi al corso di Laurea in Management & Business Analytics è richiesto, inoltre, un livello di lingua inglese non inferiore al B2 del Quadro Comune Europeo di Riferimento.' No minimum grade or GPA threshold is set for the bachelor's programme. For international pre-evaluation candidates the dossier also includes a CV and a motivation letter, assessed by the Teaching Evaluation Committee together with an online selection interview.
entry_exam_or_test: CEnT-S, delivered by CISIA (www.cisiaonline.it). It replaced the TOLC-E (English) test from 2026: 'per l'iscrizione al corso di Laurea in Management & Business Analytics, è necessario sostenere il test CEnT-S, che ha sostituito il test TOLC-E (English)'. The test is an initial-preparation assessment used only to determine OFA, not a selective ranking exam. Separately, candidates with a foreign qualification applying through Elix-Forms pre-evaluation are scheduled for an online selection interview ('colloquio di selezione online') by the Teaching Evaluation Committee, and an additional online interview may be used to assess English proficiency when no B2 certificate is presented.
entry_test_name_and_deadline: Test name: CEnT-S (CISIA). Deadline: the test must be taken by 30 November 2026 at the latest - 'il sostenimento del test dovrà avvenire entro e non oltre il 30 novembre 2026'. It may be taken BEFORE or AFTER matriculation, and may be repeated, provided it is completed by 30 November 2026: 'Il test potrà essere svolto ed eventualmente ripetuto anche successivamente all'immatricolazione, purché sia effettuato entro il 30 novembre 2026.' Passing the test is not a condition of admission. OFA threshold: a minimum of 6 total points across the 'Mathematics' and 'Reasoning on texts and data' sections (the CEnT-S equivalents of the Italian 'Matematica' and 'Logica' sections). Candidates who by 30 November 2026 have taken the test without reaching 6 points, and candidates who have not taken the test at all by that date, are assigned an OFA. The OFA must be cleared within the first year, either by passing the TOLC OFA / CEnT-S recovery test or by passing one of: Mathematics for Business (Matematica Generale), Microeconomics (Microeconomia), Statistics for Business (Statistica). Otherwise the student cannot sit second-year exams. Free CISIA MOOCs are provided as support.
reserved_places_non_eu: 30 places out of 100 are reserved for non-EU foreign students resident abroad ('di cui 30 riservati a studenti stranieri non appartenenti all'UE e residenti all'estero'). This is the largest non-EU quota among the Economia bachelor programmes (Economia e Commercio L-33 has 15 of 200). The full 2026/27 non-EU contingent table is published as Annex 1 (Allegato n.1) to the non-EU Additional Notice.
admin_seat_university: University of Udine (Università degli Studi di Udine, UNIUD) is the sole administering university - this is not an inter-university (interateneo) or joint programme. Admission, pre-evaluation, matriculation (via Esse3 at https://uniud.esse3.cineca.it), tuition and student-office services are all handled by UNIUD; the academic home is the Department of Economics and Statistics (DIES). Student office: Segreteria Studenti Economia; teaching support: didattica.dies@uniud.it.
course_status_flag: Active and NOT 'ad esaurimento'. It is a recently launched programme still phasing in: the Economia manifesto 2026/27 states 'Anni attivati: primo e secondo anno' (only the first and second years are activated for 2026/27; the third year is not yet activated). Do not confuse this with the separate Italian-taught Economia Aziendale L-18 (Ordinamento 2010), whose third year is explicitly listed as 'attivato terzo anno ad esaurimento'.
language_requirements: English at CEFR B2 or equivalent, certified. Non-negotiable for completing matriculation: 'Students who do not provide certification of English proficiency at the B2 level at the time of enrollment will generally not be eligible for admission.' Accepted certification bodies (exhaustive list in the Additional Notices): Cambridge English Language Assessment; Trinity College London; IELTS; TOEFL; Pearson Edexcel - PTE Academic; Pearson General English; Oxford Test of English; LanguageCert International ESOL; Gatehouse Awards Classic; British Council - Aptis ESOL General; British Council - Aptis ESOL Advanced. Certificates must clearly state the level achieved. Exemptions: applicants who completed a school curriculum delivered in English (IB diplomas, multilingual schools, etc.) and native English speakers (per https://www.gov.uk/english-language/exemptions) are exempt from presenting a certificate. Flexibility: a pre-evaluation application may be submitted without the certificate if the applicant is awaiting the exam or the certificate, but obtaining it remains a requirement to finalise matriculation; in the absence of a B2 certificate the competent Teaching Committee may assess English through an online interview. No Italian language certificate is required for this programme (the Italian B2 requirement applies only to Italian-taught courses).
english_level_exception: No programme-specific exception - Management & Business Analytics follows the standard B2 requirement. The only B1 exception at UNIUD applies to a different course: 'Per il corso di laurea magistrale in Management engineering, il livello di conoscenza della lingua inglese richiesto è il livello B1.' For partially English-taught courses the required Italian and English level remains B2. The practical softeners for this programme are the exemptions (English-medium schooling, native speakers) and the possibility of an online interview in lieu of a certificate, not a lower CEFR level.
english_cert_validity_years: 5 years. UNIUD general rule applied to this programme without variation: 'Saranno ritenute valide le certificazioni che non siano state conseguite da più di 5 anni' (certificates obtained more than 5 years ago are not accepted).
teaching_language_partial_flag: Fully English ('taught entirely in English'). Not a partial-English curriculum and not an English branch of an otherwise Italian programme. The Additional Notices route it through the dedicated 'DEGREES TAUGHT ENTIRELY IN ENGLISH' section of www.uniud.it/prospectivestudents, and the Economia manifesto contrasts it with the Italian-taught Economia bachelor programmes.
application_deadline_eu: Pre-evaluation window on Elix-Forms for EU / EU-resident candidates holding a foreign qualification: 01/02/2026 to 10/09/2026 - 'il candidato deve creare il profilo digitale sulla piattaforma digitale Elix-Forms ... ed inserire la scansione della seguente documentazione nel periodo compreso dal 01/02/2026 al 10/09/2026' (EU Additional Notice, section 1). Candidates holding an Italian secondary-school diploma do not go through pre-evaluation and simply apply for matriculation in the 9 July - 5 October 2026 window.
application_deadline_non_eu: Pre-evaluation window on Elix-Forms for non-EU candidates resident abroad: 01/02/2026 to 31/05/2026 - identical wording to the EU notice but with the earlier closing date ('nel periodo compreso dal 01/02/2026 al 31/05/2026', non-EU Additional Notice, section 1). This closes more than three months earlier than the EU window because of the visa procedure that follows.
universitaly_deadline: 30 June 2026 for the Universitaly pre-enrolment (study-visa) application - this is separate from and later than the 31 May 2026 UNIUD pre-evaluation deadline. 'L'aspirante studente ... DEVE creare il proprio profilo digitale sul portale UNIVERSITALY ... ed inserire la domanda digitale di PRE-ISCRIZIONE ad un corso di laurea dell'Università degli studi di Udine per l'anno accademico 2026/2027 entro e non oltre il 30 giugno 2026. Le domande di preiscrizione presentate dopo il 30 giugno 2026 non verranno valutate.' Applies to non-EU candidates requiring a study visa. Note: the separate 31 July 2026 document-upload deadline mentioned in section 5 of the non-EU notice applies only to nationally/locally programmed courses requiring a selective admission test, a list that does NOT include Management & Business Analytics. Sequence for this programme: Elix-Forms pre-evaluation (by 31/05/2026) -> letter of eligibility -> Universitaly visa pre-enrolment (by 30/06/2026) -> UNIUD validates and forwards to the consulate -> matriculation on Esse3.
decision_timeline_days: 30 working days ('entro 30 giorni lavorativi dalla data di presentazione della domanda'). Within this period from submission of a complete, paid pre-evaluation application, the Teaching Evaluation Committee schedules the online selection interview and subsequently communicates the outcome by email. Only complete applications with the fee paid are evaluated.
enrolment_window: Matriculation (immatricolazione) applications: from 9 July 2026 to 5 October 2026, 12:00 noon - 'Le domande di immatricolazione si presentano dal 9 luglio al 5 ottobre 2026 alle ore 12.00 e saranno accettate in ordine cronologico fino ad esaurimento dei posti disponibili.' IMPORTANT chronological-closure warning: places are filled first-come-first-served, so the window can close before 5 October 2026; if places are exhausted earlier a waiting list is opened (request form: lista-di-attesa_uk.pdf), filled in chronological order of request, and the Student Office contacts candidates if places free up. Late matriculation: with serious and justified reasons the Rector may accept applications after 5 October 2026 but no later than 12:00 on 15 January 2027, via a late-application request bearing a EUR 16.00 revenue stamp (marca da bollo). After starting the online Esse3 procedure the required documents must be uploaded within 30 days of registration on Esse3, on pain of cancellation of the position. Postal applications are not accepted.
required_documents: A) Elix-Forms pre-evaluation (candidates with a foreign qualification): foreign final or provisional secondary-school qualification; English language certificate at B2 or equivalent; Curriculum Vitae; motivation letter; plus payment of the non-refundable EUR 20.00 processing fee via PagoPA (or bank transfer in specific cases) - only complete, paid applications are assessed. A Dichiarazione di Valore or CIMEA statement of verification of the foreign school qualification is also required (it may be submitted after the online pre-evaluation but is necessary for the final matriculation procedure). B) Universitaly pre-enrolment (non-EU visa applicants): valid passport; passport-size photo; final or provisional secondary-school qualification; English B2 (or equivalent) certificate (Italian B2 certificate instead, if applying to an Italian-taught course). C) Matriculation upload on Esse3: copy of identity document; copy of the Italian tax code (codice fiscale); one passport-size photo; signed matriculation application; receipt of payment of the first tuition instalment (PagoPA only); authorisation from the person exercising parental responsibility if the student is a minor; copy of the residence permit (permesso di soggiorno) for non-EU citizens.
tuition_or_fees_link: https://www.uniud.it/it/tasse (redirects to https://www.uniud.it/it/didattica/area-servizi-studenti/servizi-studenti/diritto-allo-studio/tasse_merito/tasse-riduzioni-esoneri). uncertainty_notes: 1) NOT an interateneo/joint programme - UNIUD is the sole administering university, so there is no split of administrative seat, tuition or registration with another institution. 2) Terminology caution: 'accesso programmato locale' here does NOT mean a competitive ranked selection. Places are allocated strictly in chronological order of matriculation application, and the CEnT-S test only assigns OFA - it cannot exclude a candidate. UNIUD's own list of locally programmed courses that require a selective admission test explicitly excludes Management & Business Analytics. The only genuinely selective step is the pre-evaluation dossier plus online interview applied to candidates holding a foreign qualification. 3) The programme is still phasing in: the 2026/27 manifesto activates only the first and second years ('Anni attivati: primo e secondo anno'), so the third year is expected to open in 2027/28. This was not stated as a limitation anywhere, but prospective students should be aware. 4) The Universitaly 30 June 2026 deadline comes from the general visa procedure (section 3 of the non-EU notice) and therefore applies to this programme; the separate 31 July 2026 document-upload deadline in section 5 does NOT apply, since it is restricted to courses with a selective admission test. 5) CEnT-S session dates and registration fees are set by CISIA (cisiaonline.it), not by UNIUD, and are not published on uniud.it; only the 30 November 2026 cut-off is a UNIUD-set date. Per the sourcing constraint, the CISIA calendar was not cited. 6) The EU-window notice (10/09/2026) is aimed at candidates with a foreign qualification residing in the EU; candidates holding an Italian secondary-school diploma bypass pre-evaluation entirely and simply matriculate in the 9 July - 5 October 2026 window - the notices do not spell out this distinction in a single sentence, so it is inferred from the structure of the two documents. 7) Tuition amounts and ISEE-based reductions were out of scope for this field set; only the fees page link is recorded. 8) The EUR 20.00 pre-evaluation fee and the Elix-Forms platform are recorded here in free text because no dedicated structured fields exist for them.
